entities.summary: Edward Neal Peters is an American Catholic canonist and serves as a referendary of the Apostolic Signatura. He was professor of canon law at the Sacred Heart Major Seminary of the Archdiocese of Detroit from 2005 until 2025, when Archbishop Edward Weisenburger dismissed him.
